newsitem.title: FINLAND: HK RUOKATALO SAYS TO INVEST FIM 100 MLN.
newsitem.headline: HK RUOKATALO SAYS TO INVEST FIM 100 MLN.

text.p: Finnish food industry group HK Ruokatalo Oy said on Friday it would invest almost 100 million markka over the next four years to boost production capacity and develop its operations.
The investment would focus on HK Ruokatalo's chicken processing unit Broileritalo, it said.

"Broileritalo's production volumes have been growing, and by these investments the company will secure the efficient distribution and ... availability of processed poultry products," HK Ruokatalo said in a statement.
In addition to boosting production capacity, the investments would go towards developing logistics and forewarding and raising the level of value added, HK Ruokatalo said.
In 1996, Broileritalo Oy had net sales of 472.6 million markka and about 550 employees, HK Ruokatalo said.
According to food-industry statistics, poultry consumption in Finland grew 12 percent last year, and 11 percent in January through April this year, it said.
